Components / Surfaces

Card shapes

.dr-card · --row · --compact · .dr-listing__body · __name · __desc · __meta · components/card.css · kit specimen

Anatomy

Package delivery 2.3 km · ~18 min Pay₴180
  1. 1.dr-cardThe surface: --bg-surface on the page, a 1.11:1 tone step, radius 16, no border, no shadow. Inset 24 / 20. Below 390 wide the inset is 24 / 16 and the gap 18.
  2. 2.dr-listing__nameThe name, 15/600 at line-height 1.2, in --text-primary, 14.37:1.
  3. 3.dr-listing__descOne line of description, 13/400 at line-height 1.4, in --text-muted, 5.95:1, 2 under the name.
  4. 4.dr-listing__metaThe money line, 6 under the description, items 8 apart: the figure is a .dr-number, 20/700 tabular, with its word (Pay) in .sr-only for a screen reader only.
  5. 5.dr-wellThe drone doing the job, a 96 × 96 cutout with no ground, radius 13, padding 4, after the body. 68 × 68 below 390 wide.

Variants and sizes

Inventory rows: Card; Listing card.

States

No state of its own: the card is a surface, and nothing in it takes focus. A card that is one link takes the card link states, and its buttons take the button states.

When to use

A card is one object on a flat page: separated by a warm tone step and the 16 radius, never by a border or a shadow, and with no hover lift. Inside it the rhythm is 20 between groups and 4 or 8 within one; between cards it is the list's gap, which is always larger. The listing card holds the drone doing the job, the name, one line of description and, on job-offer, the money line. It carries no chevron.

The cover card is a shape of its own with no inset; see Cover card. A card that is one tap target takes an empty stretched anchor; see Card that is one link. The service-card modifier .dr-listing--service (title 17/400) is declared in components/card.css but no wireframe draws it any more, so it has no live block here.

The name is the dictionary word for the thing (Package delivery, a reviewer's name), the description is a fact with a number in it (2.3 km · ~18 min), and money is a figure with its meaning given to a screen reader in .dr-sr.

Sources: DESIGN.md § Cards · § Do's and Don'ts · inventory.md § 1.3 (Card, Listing card) · ui/kit.html Card, the other three shapes

Rule and anti-rule

Do

Don’t

Package delivery 2.3 km · ~18 min

A listing card with a borrowed chevron. The listing card has no chevron; the arrow belongs to the choice card, which is a route to another screen. For facts read in pairs use a row panel; for a group of data the user enters use a titled zone card.
